newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rallying on buying interest.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rallying on buying interest.

text.p: Dhaka shares are expected to continue their rally on Monday for a sixth straight session as the current uptrend might tempt further buying of blue chips, brokers said.

"Client orders (for buying) are rising," said Golam Sarwar of Mahbub Morshed & Co. Another broker said shares of Beximco Group might gain following Saturday's court order halting proceedings against the group's four executives. The executives were among 36 brokers and listed companies facing charges of price manipulation. The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index rose 59.14 points or 6.04 percent to 1,037.21 on Sunday.
